full_prompt_en: A square, highly detailed isometric illustration looks down into a dense arrangement of adjoining domestic rooms with their roofs and outer walls removed. Pale partitions run diagonally in a tight grid, dividing the image into many small cells. At the top left, warm yellow and pink rooms contain counters, shelves, tables, and scattered small household items. Near the top center, a dark brown cabinet and narrow corridors lead into gray-green rooms. Along the middle, several doorways open into bedrooms and sitting areas; one room has a bed with pale bedding, another has a compact table and chairs, and a tiny figure appears in a few of the spaces. Lower down, orange, muted red, mint, cream, and blue walls alternate, making each room distinguishable even where their furnishings are crowded together. Black outlines define walls, door frames, stair edges, tiles, and furniture, while minute crosshatching and stippled color give the surfaces a printed texture. The viewing angle remains consistent across the whole maze, showing both floor plans and the height of each partition. There is no exterior horizon or central foreground; the interconnected rooms continue out of all four edges. Light is even and diagrammatic, with small warm shadows beneath furniture and inside doorways rather than a single dramatic beam. The image invites slow exploration of tiny objects and paths while the repeated diagonals and pastel color blocks hold the composition together as one intricate structure.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、高度细密的等轴插画从上方望进一组密集相连的居住房间，屋顶与外墙被移除。浅色隔墙沿对角线构成紧密格网，把画面分成许多小单元。左上方暖黄和粉色房间里有柜台、架子、桌子和散落的小型日用品。靠近上部中央，深棕柜子与窄走廊通向灰绿色房间。中部多个门洞连向卧室与起居区域；一个房间有浅色床品的床，另一处有紧凑桌椅，少数空间还出现极小的人影。往下，橘色、柔红、薄荷绿、奶油色和蓝色墙面交替，使各室即便家具密集也可区分。黑色细线界定墙、门框、楼梯边缘、地砖与家具，细小排线及点状颜色赋予表面印刷质地。观看角度在整个迷宫中保持一致，同时显示地面布局和隔墙高度。没有外部地平线或中央前景；相连房间延伸出四边。光线均匀、如图解，仅在家具下和门洞内有小片暖阴影，而无单一戏剧性光束。图像鼓励视线缓慢探索小物件与路径，同时重复斜线和粉彩色块把构图维系成精密整体。
style_prompt_en: Illustration uses a consistent elevated oblique viewpoint, fine dark outlines, tiny repeated details, and tightly fitted compartments. Divide the field into many linked cells so depth comes from diagonal edges, open cutaways, and small recess shadows. Apply muted pastel blocks of cream, sage, powder blue, apricot, mustard, and dusty rose; subtle stipple and crosshatching prevent the areas from feeling mechanically flat. Keep light even across the composition to allow simultaneous inspection of all zones, with darker accents reserved for openings and structural boundaries. Small objects can form varied local rhythms without disrupting the large grid. The transferable effect is meticulous visual narration: orderly repetition at a distance and rewarding granular detail up close.
style_prompt_zh: 插画采用一致的高位斜视角、纤细深色勾线、微小重复细节与紧密嵌合的区块。将色场分成许多相连单元，让纵深来自斜向边线、敞开的剖面和小片凹处阴影。铺以奶油色、鼠尾草绿、粉蓝、杏色、芥黄和灰玫瑰色的柔和彩块；细点描与排线避免各区域显得机械扁平。全画光线均匀，便于同时检视各区，较深重点留给开口与结构边界。小物件可以形成不同局部节奏，却不打乱大格网。可迁移的效果是细密视觉叙事：远看有序重复，近看有值得探索的颗粒细节。
theme_en: An isometric cutaway of many tiny connected rooms
theme_zh: 许多相连小房间的等轴剖面图
name: Chris Ware
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
